plugins.name: bedrock
plugins.description: Adds /adopt to set a repo up with the bedrocks for Bun, Rust, Swift, and C++, and keeps Claude on bun in Bun repos.

plugins.name: claudetto
plugins.description: Tunes Claude Code for coding at the lowest token cost, through its official extension points only: settings, hooks, skills, and an output style. It patches nothing.

plugins.name: claudetto-you-should-know
plugins.description: Shows a short note above the prompt when a side check finds something about the work you likely missed. Off by default; once on, one small request every sixth step, no telemetry.

plugins.name: claudetto-openspec
plugins.description: A lean OpenSpec workflow: one deferred tool that validates, reports status, and archives a change, and six short skills. It needs no openspec executable and no network.

plugins.name: clawdipedia-docs
plugins.description: MCP server and skill for four doc sources: Clawdipedia (unofficial Claude Code docs), platform.claude.com, code.claude.com, and claude.com/resources. Searches, reads pages, serves schemas.

plugins.name: clawdipedia-docs-cli
plugins.description: The same four doc sources as a clawdipedia command for the Bash tool, plus a light skill. No MCP server, so it adds no tool list. Needs Bun. Claude Code only.

plugins.name: cc-inspect
plugins.description: MCP server and skill that read your Claude Code transcripts and the code of the installed binary: sessions, code, surface, and release. Local, except release notes and the readable view.

plugins.name: asd-ste100
plugins.description: Rewrites English in the style of ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, so that a model or a reader with no way to ask has one reading. Includes the ste-lint script for the structural rules.
